top_signals.title: Indonesia’s Selloff Deepens Across Stocks, Bonds on MSCI Risk
top_signals.summary: Indonesian markets extended their selloff, with stocks deepening their worst rout in almost 30 years and losses spreading to bonds and the rupiah after MSCI Inc. warned the country may face a two-step downgrade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
